# .github

Owner: **Hisham**.

Pull-request template and future CI planning documentation.

| Boundary | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| Receives | Issue scope, peer review rules and meaningful future checks. |
| Produces | Consistent review evidence and later narrowly scoped automation. |
| Consumers and dependencies | All contributors and integrated main branch. |
| Never store here | Invented usernames, tokens, automatic deployments or active workflows in the scaffold. |

## Directory contents

| Entry | Purpose |
|---|---|
| [workflows/](workflows/README.md) | README describing future CI responsibilities; no YAML workflow. |
| [PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md](PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md) | PR review prompts for purpose, module, interfaces, dependencies, evidence, contract impact and reviewer. |
| `README.md` | This directory guide: owner, inputs/outputs, consumers, exclusions and child-file responsibilities. |
